title: PK Document Tracking System - User Guide

sections.title: Start here
steps: Use Hardcopy Documents for paper records and Softcopy Documents for approved electronic files.
Use External Documents for documents received from outside the organization.
Use My Requests to ask for a change. Use My Tasks to review assigned requests or record a physical handoff.
With the required permission, you can add or change documents directly in their document lists.
Read each result message. Select Got it to close it, then check the record or request status.
sections.result: You know where to start and what to check after each action.
notes: Your roles and permissions determine which menus, records and actions you can use.
Saving a request draft does not change a document, its holder, its access or its status.

sections.title: Who does what
steps: Administrator manages accounts, permissions, approval processes, setup records, audit and backups.
Document Control Officer manages documents, assignments, storage places, categories and document control records.
Plant Manager reviews assigned requests and uses the document access granted to their account.
Internal Auditor reviews documents, histories and audit records within their access.
Staff uses assigned or shared documents and submits requests within their access.
sections.result: Each person uses their own account and works within their access.
notes: These are the standard duties. Administrators can change permissions or add roles.
Primary role and Assigned roles work together. You can decide a task only when it is assigned to you or one of your roles.

Download Locked Files lets a role download and open locked approved files. Administrator has it; an Administrator can grant it to other roles, such as Document Control Officer, in Roles & Permissions.

sections.title: Sign in and set your password
steps: Enter Username and Password, then select Sign In.
If Change your temporary password appears, enter Current or temporary password, New password and Confirm new password.
Choose a different password with at least 9 characters. Select Set permanent password.
To change it later, open your account name and choose Change Password. Complete the fields, then select Update Password and Confirm.
When finished, open your account name, select Sign Out and confirm.
sections.result: You can open the menus available to your account.
notes: Contact the Administrator if you forget your password or your account is disabled.
After repeated failed sign-ins, wait before trying again or ask the Administrator for help.
If a message says your password is too long, shorten it and try again.

sections.title: Find your way around
steps: Open Overview to see your totals and recent activity.
Under Document Management, choose Hardcopy Documents, Softcopy Documents or External Documents.
Open My Requests to start or follow a request. Open My Tasks for work assigned to you.
Document controllers with permission use Document Assignments and Master Data.
Administrators also use User Management, Roles & Permissions, Workflow Builder and Backup & Restore.
sections.result: You can find the page for the work you need to do.
notes: If a menu or action is missing, your account may not have the required permission.
On a narrow screen, use the menu button to show or hide the sidebar.

sections.title: Find and view a document
steps: Open the document list you need and choose Table or Folder.
Search by title or reference. Narrow the results with the available filters.
In Folder view, expand a storage place or category. Use the folder links or path above the list to move between folders.
Select a title or View to read the full record. Use Previous, Next or the page controls for more results.
sections.result: You can read the document records available to your account.
notes: Hardcopy folders follow Area, Specific, optional Asset, then Location. Softcopy and External folders use separate categories.
If a document seems missing, clear the filters and return to All Documents.

sections.title: Register a hardcopy
sections.audience: Administrator or authorized holder / document controller
steps: Open Hardcopy Documents and select Add New Hardcopy Document.
Enter Document Title. Choose Area, Specific, optional Asset and Location.
Check Current Holder. Administrators can choose an active user; other users register themselves as holder.
If needed, turn on Track retention period and enter Retention Start and Retention End. Add optional Reason / Notes.
Select Save Document, check the confirmation and select Confirm.
sections.result: The Active record appears immediately with its holder and storage place.
notes: Choose a Location that belongs to the selected storage places. Asset is optional.
Register hardcopies here. New hardcopy creation requests are unavailable.

sections.title: Update a hardcopy record
steps: Open Hardcopy Documents, find the Active record and open View Details.
Select Edit. Update Document Title, storage choices or retention settings as needed.
Check Current Holder and any retention dates.
Select Save Document and Confirm. Reopen View Details to check the saved changes.
sections.result: Your permitted changes take effect immediately.
notes: Use a Hardcopy Transfer Request when the physical handoff needs approval.
New hardcopy update requests are unavailable. If someone else changed the record, refresh and check it again.
Reason / Notes is saved during registration only. Changing it during Edit does not save a new note.

sections.title: Check who holds a hardcopy
steps: Find the record in Hardcopy Documents and open View Details.
Check Holder and the full Area, Specific, Asset and Location details.
Review Related Requests, approval history and transfer history when available.
Before collecting or releasing the original, confirm the holder and any unfinished transfer.
sections.result: You know who holds the original and where it should be stored.
notes: Transfer approval alone does not change the holder or location. The recipient must Accept the handoff.
Assignment changes the holder without recording a physical handoff.

sections.title: Create a softcopy directly
steps: Open Softcopy Documents and select Add New Softcopy Document. Set Softcopy Action to Create Softcopy.
Enter Subject / Reason and Proposed Document Title. Choose Category and check Generated Document Number.
To reuse a number with a new series, follow Use document and series numbers.
Attach Document File. Set Revision Level, and add Effective Date and Remarks if needed.
Select Approve Directly and Confirm. Check the success message and the new record.
sections.result: The Active softcopy and its approved file are ready immediately at revision 00.
notes: The displayed document number is a preview. The final number is assigned when the action completes.
Document File is required. A blank Effective Date uses the approval date.

sections.title: Revise a softcopy directly
steps: Open Softcopy Documents, find the Active document and select Edit. A locked document has no Edit.
Check Existing Softcopy Document, then set Revision Level.
Enter Subject / Reason, Proposed Document Title and Number of Pages. Correct Series No. if needed.
Attach the replacement Document File. Select Approve Directly and Confirm.
Reopen the record and check the current revision and file.
sections.result: The replacement file is current immediately. The revision level increases automatically.
notes: The document keeps its number, series and category.
Earlier revisions remain in the history you can view. Their files are not available as the current approved copy.
A document with a locked file is read-only: it has no Edit and cannot be picked for revision.

sections.title: Request a new softcopy
steps: Open My Requests, choose Softcopy Request and select New Request.
Choose Create Softcopy. Enter Subject / Reason and Proposed Document Title, then choose Category.
Check Generated Document Number. To reuse a number with a new series, select Need Series Number?.
Attach Document File and add optional Remarks. Select Save Draft and Confirm.
Check View Details, including the file preview on its Document File tab. Select Submit, Continue and Confirm.
sections.result: Final approval creates the Active softcopy and its approved file at revision 00.
notes: Attach a file before submission. This request form has no Effective Date field.
The final document number is assigned at final approval and may differ from the preview.

sections.title: Request a softcopy revision
sections.audience: Authorized requesters with access to the document
steps: Open My Requests, choose Softcopy Request and select New Request.
Choose Revise Softcopy and select Existing Softcopy Document.
Check Proposed Document Title. Enter Subject / Reason and Number of Pages.
Attach the replacement Document File and add optional Remarks. Select Save Draft and Confirm.
Check the file preview on the Document File tab of View Details, then select Submit, Continue and Confirm.
sections.result: Final approval makes the replacement file current and increases the revision level.
notes: Documents marked Locked - read-only are disabled in Existing Softcopy Document.
When editing a draft, keep its attachment or upload a replacement.
Softcopy cancellation requests are unavailable. Ask an authorized controller if the document needs disposal.

sections.title: Use document and series numbers
steps: For a new document, choose a Document Number Pattern category (not a Folder) and leave Need Series Number? unchecked.
Check Generated Document Number. The category Code Pattern sets its prefix and sequence.
For the first series, check Need Series Number?, select an existing Document No. and enter a one-time Series No. Code Pattern.
The new Series Number is filled in automatically; edit it to use a different one. For sample-series-002, the original becomes sample-series-001.
Finish the direct creation or request steps.
sections.result: The record gets a new category number or an existing number with a unique series.
notes: Each Document No. stores its own series pattern after first approval. Future series increment automatically; revisions keep their series.
If the preview is blank or no number is available, ask the controller to check the category.

sections.title: Register an external document directly
steps: Open External Documents and select Add New External Document.
Enter Document Title, choose Category and add an optional Description.
Select Attach Files and choose up to 20 PDF or image files (15 MB per file).
Select Save Directly and Confirm.
Find the new record and select View to check its details and current attachments.
sections.result: The Active external document and its approved attachments are ready immediately at revision 00.
notes: Every later revision needs at least one replacement attachment.
External documents have their own categories and no retention fields.

sections.title: Revise an external document directly
steps: Open External Documents, find the Active document and select Edit.
Check or update Document Title, Description and Category.
Select Attach Files and choose up to 20 replacement PDF or image files (15 MB per file).
Select Save Directly and Confirm.
Select View to check the document details in the header and inspect current attachments. Use Download when permitted.
sections.result: The details and current attachments change immediately. The revision level increases automatically.
notes: You can revise only an Active external document you have permission to manage.
Download gives you each current approved attachment.
Earlier revision records and files remain stored, but External Documents has no separate File History action.

sections.title: Request a new external document
steps: Open My Requests, choose External Document Request and select New Request.
Set External Document Action to External Create Request. Enter Subject / Reason.
Enter Document Title, choose External Category and add an optional Description.
Select Attach Files and choose up to 20 PDF or image files (15 MB each). Add optional Remarks, then Save Draft and Confirm.
Check View Details and review each attachment. Select Submit, Continue and Confirm.
sections.result: Final approval registers the Active external document and its approved attachments at revision 00.
notes: External Categories are separate from Softcopy Categories.
Attach at least one file before submission. External documents have no retention dates.

sections.title: Request an external document revision
sections.audience: Authorized requesters with access to the document
steps: Open My Requests, choose External Document Request and select New Request.
Choose External Revised Request and select Existing External Document.
Enter Subject / Reason. Check or update Document Title, External Category and Description.
Attach at least one replacement file (up to 20), add optional Remarks, then Save Draft and Confirm.
Review each attachment, then select Submit, Continue and Confirm.
sections.result: Final approval updates the external document and makes its next revision current.
notes: Choose an Active external document available to your account.
When editing a draft, existing attachments are kept; newly selected files are added to them.

sections.title: Preview, download and view file history
sections.audience: Users with the required file permissions
steps: Open Softcopy Documents, find the Active document, select View and open the Document Files tab to preview the current file.
Word and Excel files are shown as a PDF made by LibreOffice. The file you uploaded is kept unchanged.
Select Fullscreen to enlarge the preview. If the file is not locked, you can also select Download.
For Word or Excel, Download Original saves the uploaded file and Download PDF saves the converted copy.
Use File History or Document Files for revision details. Open View on an external document to preview its PDF or image attachments.
sections.result: You can read the current approved file, and download it when it is unlocked or you hold Download Locked Files access.
notes: External documents take up to 20 PDF or image files per upload, 15 MB each.
Normal downloads exclude files of superseded, disposed and cancelled documents.
A locked file is read-only: it can be previewed, but Download needs Download Locked Files access.
The first Word or Excel preview takes a few seconds to convert.

sections.title: Preview a request attachment
sections.audience: Requester or the currently assigned approver
steps: Find the softcopy or external request in My Requests or My Tasks and select View.
Open the Document File tab to read the proposed PDF, image, text, Word or Excel file in the browser.
Select Fullscreen to enlarge it. Word and Excel files appear as a PDF.
Download Original or Download PDF appears only if the file is not locked or you hold Download Locked Files access.
Return to the request to update the proposal or record your decision.
sections.result: You can check the proposed file before submission or approval.
notes: Only the requester and the currently assigned approver can preview a request attachment, while the request is a draft, returned or submitted.
Previewing does not change the system file. To correct a file, the requester must attach the revised file.
Request attachments are for preview and download only; there is no Print action.

sections.title: Save, submit and track a request
steps: Complete the New Request form. Select Save Draft and Confirm.
Check View Details. Use Edit to change your Draft or Returned request.
Select Submit, Continue and Confirm to send it for approval.
Follow Status, Approval Process Timeline and Workflow Activity Log. Correct and resubmit a Returned request.
Cancel an unwanted Draft. If Delete appears on its Cancelled record, confirm to permanently remove that never-submitted draft.
sections.result: The request shows its progress from Draft to Submitted and its final outcome.
notes: You cannot edit or cancel a Submitted request. Rejected requests are closed.
Most final approvals produce Completed. A transfer still needs Dispatch and Accept.
A Returned request keeps its original approval process when resubmitted.

sections.title: Approve, return or reject a request
sections.audience: Assigned approvers, including requesters asked to confirm
steps: Open My Tasks and choose the request tab.
Open View Details. Check the proposal, Approval Process Timeline and Workflow Activity Log.
For softcopy or external creation and revision, open View Details and check the Document File preview before deciding.
Choose Approve, Return or Reject. Add an optional Remark, then select Continue and Confirm.
Check the result and the next task or request status.
sections.result: Approve moves the request forward; Return sends it back for review; Reject closes it.
notes: At the first step, Return sends the request to its requester for correction.
At a later step, Return sends it to the previous approver. Its status stays Submitted.
The approval process assigns each task and may include a Requester account confirmation step.
A Locked badge in Approval Process Timeline and Workflow Activity Log marks the approval that locked the attached file. Until then that step shows Locks file on approval.

sections.title: Know who reviews each request
steps: Softcopy and External Create or Revise: Requester's leader, then Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer.
Hardcopy Transfer and Document Access: Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer, then Requester confirmation.
Document Assignment: Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer, then Requester's leader.
Disposal: Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer, then Requester confirmation.
Check Approval Process Timeline for the next reviewer. Administrators can check the published route in Workflow Builder.
sections.result: You can see whose review or confirmation is needed next.
notes: These routes reflect the local review on 5 November 2026. Authorized administrators can change routes for future submissions.
Submitted and Returned requests keep their original route, even if the default route changes.
Requester confirmation is an approval task in My Tasks. Transfer Dispatch and Accept are separate steps.

sections.title: Request a hardcopy transfer
steps: Open My Requests, choose Hardcopy Transfer Request and select New Request.
Choose Hardcopy Document. Check Original Places and Holder.
Choose Destination Area, Specific, optional Asset and Location. Select Receiving User.
Enter Request Subject and optional Remarks. Select Save Draft and Confirm.
Check the proposal, then select Submit, Continue and Confirm.
sections.result: Final approval marks the handoff For Transfer. The requester can then Dispatch it.
notes: Choose a different active destination with matching storage choices.
The holder and location stay unchanged until the named recipient accepts the document.
Another submitted access, assignment or transfer request for you and this document may block submission.

sections.title: Dispatch an approved hardcopy
steps: After final approval, open My Tasks and choose Hardcopy Transfer Request.
Find the document under Physical Transfer Handoffs. Check that its stage is For Transfer.
Confirm the recipient and arrange the physical release.
Select Dispatch, Continue and Confirm.
Check that the stage is now In Transit.
sections.result: Dispatch is recorded. The named recipient can confirm receipt.
notes: Only the original requester can Dispatch. Being the holder alone does not allow it.
Dispatch does not change the recorded holder or location.

sections.title: Accept a transferred hardcopy
steps: Receive the physical document. Check that it matches the approved transfer.
Open My Tasks and choose Hardcopy Transfer Request. Find the In Transit item under Physical Transfer Handoffs.
Check the document and approved destination.
Select Accept, Continue and Confirm.
Open Hardcopy Documents and check the new holder and location.
sections.result: The handoff is Accepted and the request is Completed. The holder and location now match the approved transfer.
notes: Only the named recipient can Accept. Tell the controller if the holder, active location or destination no longer matches.
The previous holder's personal access grants end when this handoff changes the holder.

sections.title: Request or renew document access
steps: Open My Requests, choose Document Access Request and select New Request.
Choose Document Type: Softcopy or Hardcopy. Select the document and enter Subject.
Check that Recipient / Assigned User is your account. Set Access Expires At to a date after today.
Add optional Remarks. Select Save Draft and Confirm, then Submit, Continue and Confirm.
After completion, reopen the document list. To extend access, submit a new request with a later expiry date.
sections.result: Final approval gives your account access through the selected expiry date.
notes: Access is for you. It does not change the holder or move the document.
Download and print need separate permissions. This request does not cover external documents.
An unfinished related request for you and the same document may block submission.

sections.title: Request a document assignment
steps: Open My Requests, choose Document Assignment Request and select New Request.
Choose Document Type: Softcopy or Hardcopy, then select the document.
Enter Subject. Check that Recipient / Assigned User is your account.
Add optional Remarks. Select Save Draft and Confirm, then Submit, Continue and Confirm.
After completion, check the document's holder or assignment.
sections.result: Final approval assigns the document to you. For hardcopies, the holder changes and the location stays the same.
notes: Softcopy assignment adds or reactivates your assignment. Other assignees stay assigned.
Use a transfer request when physical movement and receipt must be recorded.
This request does not cover external documents.

sections.title: Request hardcopy or external disposal
steps: Open My Requests, choose Disposal Request and select New Request.
Enter Subject / Reason. Choose Document Type: Hardcopy or External Document.
Select the Active document and check its details in the document list.
Choose Disposal Reason: Shred, Scratch or Other. For Other, enter Other Reason. Add optional Remarks.
Select Save Draft and Confirm, then Submit, Continue and Confirm. After completion, find the record with the Disposed filter.
sections.result: Final approval marks the document Disposed and records the disposal details.
notes: Other Reason is required for Other and can contain up to 250 characters.
For softcopies, an authorized controller uses direct Dispose. There is no softcopy disposal request.
Retention alerts do not submit or approve disposal.

sections.title: Dispose of a document directly
steps: Open Hardcopy Documents, Softcopy Documents or External Documents. Check the Active record.
Select Dispose on the correct document.
Choose Disposal Reason: Shred, Scratch or Other. For Other, enter Other Reason.
Check the document and reason, then select Continue and Confirm.
Use the Disposed filter to find the record and check the result.
sections.result: The record becomes Disposed immediately and its disposal history is saved.
notes: You need direct action and disposal permissions, plus access to manage the document.
Normal download actions are unavailable for disposed softcopy and external files.
Also follow your organization's physical disposal procedure.

sections.title: Assign documents directly
steps: Open Document Assignments. Choose Hardcopy / Places or Softcopy / Categories.
Select Assign Document, choose the document and Assigned User, then select Save Assignment and Confirm.
For all hardcopies in a place, choose Location and Assigned User. Select Assign All and Confirm.
For softcopies in a category, choose Category / Subcategory and Assigned User. Select Assign All and Confirm.
Read the result message and check the assignments.
sections.result: Hardcopy assignment changes the holder. Softcopy assignment adds the user and keeps other active assignees.
notes: Assign All includes softcopy subcategories or Active hardcopies at the selected Location.
Finish For Transfer or In Transit handoffs before assigning those hardcopies.
Assignment does not record Dispatch or Accept.

sections.title: Check hardcopy retention dates
steps: When adding or editing a hardcopy, turn on Track retention period if monitoring is needed.
Enter Retention Start and Retention End. The end date must be on or after the start date.
Use Due Today, Overdue, Due in the Next 7 Days or Due in 8-30 Days to find records needing review.
Open View Details to check Days until disposal. If permitted, use Edit to view Retention Start and Retention End.
When Retention period reached appears, review the records and select Got it. Follow the approved disposal process if needed.
sections.result: You can identify hardcopies whose retention dates need review.
notes: Alerts cover Active hardcopies you can see with an end date of today or earlier.
Closing an alert does not change or dispose of a document.
External documents have no retention fields.

sections.title: Set up physical storage locations
steps: Open Master Data. Use the Area, Specific, Asset and Location tabs.
Add an Area, then a Specific within it. Add an Asset Number under that Specific if needed.
Add a Location. Enter Location Name, Sequence, Area and Specific. Add Asset Number and Archive Date if needed.
Select Save Record and Confirm. Use Edit to correct an entry.
Select Deactivate to stop offering an entry in new selections. Use Active or Inactive to check its status.
sections.result: Document forms offer the active storage places you have set up.
notes: Sequence must be unique within a Specific. Leave it blank for an automatic number. Keep each entry under the correct parent.
Deactivation keeps past links. Resolve any linked-record warning before trying again.

sections.title: Set up softcopy and external categories
steps: Open Master Data and choose Softcopy Categories or External Categories.
Select Add Softcopy Categories or Add External Categories. Enter Name and Folder. Add Description and Parent Id if needed.

For Softcopy Categories, choose Category Type: Folder to nest a parent folder (no code pattern), or Document Number Pattern to generate documents. Numbering patterns increment the numeric segment after the final dash, e.g. PPM-001 to PPM-002.
Keep Active checked. Select Save Record and Confirm.
Use Edit to update a category, or Deactivate to stop offering it in new selections.
sections.result: Each document type has its own folders. Softcopy Code Pattern controls document numbering.
notes: External Categories have no Code Pattern. Folder-only Softcopy Categories have no numbering pattern; nested Folder categories can parent Document Number Pattern categories.
A category cannot be its own parent or be placed inside one of its subcategories.

sections.title: Manage user accounts
steps: Open User Management. Select Add User or Edit an existing account.
Enter the person's name, Username, Position Title, Primary role, Assigned roles and Leader as needed. Check Active account.
Select Save User and Confirm. Share the generated temporary password with that person through your approved channel.
To reset a password, Edit the account. Select Generate a new temporary password for this existing account, then Save User and Confirm.
Use Assigned Documents to check assigned records when available. Select Deactivate when an eligible account should stop signing in.
sections.result: The account has the selected access. The user must change a generated temporary password before continuing.
notes: Temporary passwords appear once. Reset the password if the user loses it.
You cannot deactivate yourself or remove the last active Administrator.
Account protections may prevent changes to your own roles or protected Administrator accounts.

sections.title: Manage roles and permissions
steps: Open Roles & Permissions. Select Add Role or Edit an editable role.
Enter Role Name and choose Module Permissions.
Check document visibility, direct actions, requests, file actions and administration separately.
Select Save Role and Confirm. Check the user's Primary role and Assigned roles in User Management.
For an unused role, select Deactivate or Remove only when offered.
sections.result: All active roles assigned to an account contribute to its menus and actions.
notes: The Administrator role is protected.
Before removing a role, resolve its links to users, approval processes and unfinished requests.
A role name alone does not receive tasks. The approval process must assign a step to that role.

sections.title: Set up an approval process
steps: Open Workflow Builder. Find the request process and select Step Actions.
Select Create Next Draft, or Start First Draft if no version exists.
Select Add Approval Step or Edit. Enter Approval Step Name and Approver Type. Choose a role or person when needed, then Save Step.
Set the order with Move Up and Move Down. Remove any unwanted step.
Check the order and active approvers. Select Validate & Publish and confirm.
sections.result: New submissions use the published default approval process.
notes: Approver types: Any active member of role, Specific user, Requester's leader, or Requester account.
Publish 1 to 30 valid steps with active approvers. Submitted and Returned requests keep their original process.
For Softcopy and External Create or Revise, choose a Document-locking approver; that step's approval locks the file.

sections.title: Find tasks from notifications
sections.audience: Assigned approvers and other task recipients
steps: Check the My Tasks count and notification bell for work needing your attention.
Open Notifications. Choose an item to open its My Tasks page.
Use Previous, Next and Rows to browse unread notifications.
If Approval needed appears, check the listed tasks and open the request.
Complete the approval or handoff in My Tasks.
sections.result: You reach the task where you can record the required action.
notes: Opening a bell item marks it read. It does not decide or finish the task.
Selecting Got it closes a notice without completing the work.
My Requests counts Draft and Returned items. My Tasks counts pending work.

sections.title: Review the audit trail
sections.audience: Administrator, Internal Auditor, or authorized reviewer
steps: Open Internal Audit Trail.
Search by user ID, action, subject, recorded time or outcome. Search does not match displayed user names.
Choose All Results, Success or Failed. Set date filters and adjust the order or page controls.
Select View. Check Recorded At, User, Action, Subject, Result and Details.
Compare the event with the document details or the request Workflow Activity Log.
sections.result: You can trace recorded actions within your audit access.
notes: Success and Failed help you tell completed actions from unsuccessful attempts.
The audit trail is for review. Correct records on their management pages.

sections.title: Create and manage backups
steps: Open Backup & Restore. Check for setup or backup errors.
Select Backup now and Confirm. Wait for the result.
Find an archive with Search or the Manual, Automatic or Recovery filter. Select Download to save a copy.
To add an archive, select Import backup and choose Backup ZIP. Select Import backup and Confirm.
Select Clean up and Confirm to remove eligible backup, audit and log archives older than three months.
sections.result: Successful backups appear in the list. Imported archives are checked before being stored.
notes: Backup actions need the appropriate view and edit permissions.
The page shows a daily 5:00 PM Asia/Manila schedule. Check Last automatic backup for a recent run.
If setup is incomplete, ask the Administrator for help before relying on automatic backups.

sections.title: Restore a backup
steps: Open Backup & Restore. Identify the archive that should replace the current records and private files.
Select Restore system data and choose Backup to restore.
Enter Your password. Enter RESTORE in Type RESTORE to confirm.
Select Restore selected backup. Read the replacement message and select Confirm.
A successful restore signs you out. Sign in again and check the restored records and attachments.
sections.result: A recovery backup is created, then the selected backup replaces the current records and private files.
notes: Restore affects all users. Follow your organization's recovery procedure and coordinate the timing.
Check the archive and date before confirming.
If an error appears, read the full result and investigate before trying again.

sections.title: Get help with common problems
steps: Missing menu, record or action: clear filters and check the document status. Ask the Administrator to check your roles and access.
Upload failed: check the file type and 15 MB limit, then attach the correct file again.
Submit failed: check required fields and the attachment. Ask the Administrator to check the approval process and active approvers.
Record changed elsewhere: refresh, check the latest details and repeat only the changes still needed.
Action failed: read Action could not be completed. Give the controller the request reference, action, time and message.
sections.result: You can fix common input problems or give the right information to the person helping you.
notes: If numbering fails, check that the selected Document No. exists, its first-time pattern is valid, and the per-document series-pattern migration and unique index are installed.
If a file preview does not load, close View Details and open it again. Submit a new request if document access has expired.
Keep your password private and use your own account for every action.
